minutes.headline: Building committee reviewed TCP reuse floor plans, school office needs and parking; quorum lapsed and the meeting adjourned.
minutes.summary: The committee heard the superintendent describe school administration office needs, then the architects showed room-by-room layouts for school, Boys and Girls Club, food pantry and conference spaces. Engineers covered HVAC, electrical, sprinklers, lead in water, and site parking and access. A member noted quorum was lost late in the meeting, and adjournment was moved for lack of quorum.

public_comment.topic: Chair asked for public comment; none offered.

votes.motion: Adjourn due to lack of quorum at 8:24 p.m.

budget_items.topic: Replacement of existing ductwork and finishes
budget_items.what_was_said: Engineer said existing ductwork is old and not worth keeping; finishes, floors and windows also need replacement.
A member argued blocking off a door is more cost effective than replacing it; architect said it depends on use.
Architect said fixed partitions may be cheaper for individual offices; movable partitions seldom move.
Electrical engineer expects service and panel upgrades due to cooling and a possible kitchen.
Phasing the work would be more expensive than vacating, per earlier discussion with the architects.

budget_items.topic: Cost estimates for November town meeting update
budget_items.what_was_said: Hope to have relative cost ideas by November for an update article.

decisions.decision: Architects will send packages to each department comparing program space to the current plan for sign-off, aiming to finish in a week to a week and a half.
Plan an update article for the November 17 town meeting, with information compiled by end of October.
Next meeting September 29, with further meetings weekly in October.
Skate park sketch to be sent to the architects to check against access road options.

what_happened.line: The committee set a November 17 town meeting update article, with information to be compiled by the end of October.
Architects will send each department a comparison of program space against the current plan for sign-off, aiming for a week to a week and a half.
Engineers said the existing ductwork is old and not worth keeping, and that electrical service and panels will likely need upgrading.
Phasing the work would cost more than vacating the building, per earlier discussion with the architects.
The meeting adjourned for lack of quorum; the next meeting is September 29, with weekly meetings in October.

why_it_matters: The reuse plan's cost depends on choices still open, such as replacing ductwork, upgrading electrical service and whether to vacate the building during work, and these shape what voters may be asked to fund at town meeting.
No votes were taken, so no spending was approved; the November update article is the first point where residents may see relative cost estimates.
